issue.title: Report theme hues on pomodoro_past_segment picker rows and tint Bob Mac Capture segment rows with them

task_type_fields.proposal: Add Bob-reported component themes and hues to `capture-complete` `pomodoro_past_segment` rows. Use the same `themes` shape that named Pomodoro rows already expose ("Named rows expose their component themes and hues", src/native/capture_complete/cli.rs). It applies to `kind: pomodoro` rows, and probably to the tail and head rows, which name the neighbouring Pomodoro. Resolve hues through the existing pomodoro_themes catalog so they follow decisions:theme-hue-is-config-pin-exempt-area-hash. Then have Bob Mac Capture render the Pomodoro row tint from that field (`CompletionRowContent.swift` `pomodoro_past_segment` case), keeping the text badge. The additive field must be omitted when no theme applies. Regenerate the Mac fixtures with `Scripts/generate-pomodoro-past-fixtures.sh` and document the field in docs/reference/json-outputs.md and the Mac docs/protocol.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-hj's binding wire contract for segment rows lists replacement/label/kind/edge/start/end/minutes/needs_repair/index/name/line and no hue. Adding one is a new cross-repo contract change (bob-cli plus bob-mac-capture with fixtures and macOS CI), not a defect in the shipped feature.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-hj.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1): the past-segment picker wire carries no theme hue, so Bob Mac Capture tints Pomodoro segment rows generically instead of with the hue Bob reports everywhere else.
